takeaways: Interfaces matter as much as scale.
Composable systems are the emerging default.

body.text: Model evolution is usually narrated as size. Builders experience it as new interfaces: tools, structured outputs, reasoning traces, agent runtimes, routers, decision APIs.

Dated entries (verify before reuse): 15 Sep 2026 TypeSafe launches Jev/System One blog; 17 Sep 2026 LangChain harness post; 19–20 Sep 2026 independent/OpenRouter/LangSmith eval publications appear; ongoing 2026 — frontier labs ship agent APIs and reasoning updates on short cycles. This list is intentionally short and sourced; we will not invent release events.
Track interfaces and economics as carefully as parameter counts.

Evolution note: specialisation and orchestration repeatedly outperform naive scale on production KPIs when latency budgets are tight, when actions are tool-mediated, and when evaluation is continuous. That does not mean small models always win — it means architecture is part of intelligence. TenthMatrix Insights will revise this living section when verified primary sources document material shifts, preserving prior snapshots via article Updated timestamps and benchmark version labels. Engineers should subscribe to provider changelogs, not only to social highlight reels. Pair every model upgrade with a diff on your golden set. If quality is flat and cost drops, keep the upgrade. If cost drops and false negatives rise on safety gates, roll back. Evolution without evaluation is just churn.
